text:
alex: Hey team — planning a CMK migration for S3 archives and RDS snapshots next week. Goal: re-encrypt all existing archival objects and encrypted DB snapshots with new CMK (arn:aws:kms:...:alias/redwood-arch-kms). Need to confirm RBAC changes, audit logging, and restore playbook. High-level steps I have: 1) create CMK with key policy + allow-list for dedicated accounts 2) run re-encrypt job for S3 objects 3) re-encrypt snapshots via CopySnapshot with KmsKeyId 4) update IAM roles/trust to allow snapshot restores 5) enable CloudTrail Data Events for s3 and kms logs. Questions below — can folks weigh in?

maria: thanks alex. couple quick asks: do we have a list of buckets + snapshot ids? also who will own key admin? last time key policy changes locked some ops out. :grimacing:

tyler: I can produce bucket list and snapshot manifest. will also include lifecycle rules. repo: https://gitlab.redwood/infra/backup-manifests

tyler: snippet of the re-encrypt command i was thinking for s3 objects: 
```
aws s3 cp s3://old-bucket/path s3://new-bucket/path --metadata-directive REPLACE --sse aws:kms --sse-kms-key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:alias/redwood-arch-kms
```
keisha: For RDS snapshots we should use CopySnapshot with KmsKeyId to change encryption; also remember cross-region copy if we want geo redundancy. Example:
```
aws rds copy-db-snapshot --source-db-snapshot-identifier arn:aws:rds:...:snapshot:rds-snap-123 --target-db-snapshot-identifier migrated-snap-123 --kms-key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/xxxxx
```

alex: good. On RBAC: propose two roles 1) key-admin (can schedule rotate + modify key policy) limited to security ops + infra leads 2) key-operator (can use decrypt/encrypt) for services/backup jobs. We need to draft a minimal key policy and IAM role bindings that avoid granting iam:CreatePolicy or iam:PutRolePolicy. Thoughts?

maria: agree on separation. Also add a read-only 'key-audit' role that has kms:DescribeKey and logs access for SRE/Compliance. Audit logging: enable CloudTrail with KMS and S3 data events, and ship to secure log bucket with separate CMK and lock-down. We should add a Lambda to detect unencrypted-object events and alert.

keisha: vuln triage note — CVE-2024-xxxx affected the S3 client validation lib; ensure backup pipeline images are patched before running re-encrypt. I'll open a ticket to patch images and add immutable image digest pins.

alex: thanks. On restores: need a clear runbook. Proposal: for restore, authorized role must have kms:Decrypt on CMK + s3:GetObject; if restoring a snapshot that was re-encrypted to new CMK, cross-account restores require grant in key policy. We should add statement example. Anyone volunteer to draft playbook steps + rollback? :raised_hands:

tyler: I can draft the restore playbook (will include canary on a dev snapshot first). Also will add an automated pre-check that ensures required IAM principals are present in key policy before copy.

maria: small ops question — do we want to rotate CMK after migration or use alias swap pattern? rotation has implications for key policy if external principals are added.

alex: prefer alias-swap for minimal blast radius; then schedule regular automatic rotation ONCE trust is stable. also plan for key escrow to HSM vendor — need PO approval. 

sre-bot: [alert] scheduled maintenance window for snapshots migration: 2026-03-25 02:00-06:00 UTC. Expect transient increased S3 API rate. 

deploy-bot: deploy pipeline triggered: infra/backup-reencrypt-job (sha:abc123) — running staging job now.

tyler: staging job passed smoke; found one object with legacy AES-CBC metadata header — will patch converter. will re-run.

keisha: +1 on runbook draft from tyler. i'll coordinate vuln patch ticket and add QA for older client behavior. 

alex: next steps: tyler to open PR with playbook and pre-checks, maria to draft key policies, keisha to own vuln patch, I'll draft communication for support and update incident runbook in case a restore fails. We'll sync tomorrow 10am PST. Thanks all :thumbsup:
